question: In the lithium-mediated ammonia review's comparison of electrolysers, which electrolyte does the gas diffusion electrode flow cell with 300 h stability use, and what faradaic and energy efficiencies does it reach?
expect: LiBF4 in C2H5OH/DG (diglyme); FE 64%, EE 17% (at −6 mA cm−2) (Table 1)
rendered:
According to page 11 of the document, the gas diffusion electrode flow cell with 300 h stability uses a DG solvent, LiBF4 electrolyte, and ethanol proton carrier. 

The faradaic efficiency and energy efficiency of this system are not directly mentioned in the question, but according to the comparison table on page 10 (Table 1), a gas diffusion electrode flow cell with LiBF4 C2H5OH/THF electrolyte achieves a faradaic efficiency of 61 ± 1% and an energy efficiency of 13 ± 1% at 1 bar.
